evals.prompt: 既存の .sdd/requirement/notification.md に、未読メッセージ数をバッジ表示する新要求を追加(--amend)
evals.expected_output: PRD amend that inserts new UR/FR into .sdd/requirement/notification.md while preserving existing UR_001/FR_001 and front matter (except updated/sdd-version), continuing the ID sequence, following an explicit --amend mode, and stamping sdd-version.

assertions.text: Existing UR_001/FR_001 content is preserved unchanged
Existing front matter fields (status, priority, risk, tags) are left unchanged except updated/sdd-version
New requirements (badge display) are correctly added with continuing IDs
sdd-version field is present in front matter
An explicit --amend concept/mode exists and was followed (not an ad-hoc judgment call)
